annotations.title: Find clothes that look like a picture

description: Wardrobe Connect. Find clothes that look like a picture of one item. Takes the picture's direct https link and, if wanted, a few words naming the item, a size, a price limit, the condition and a country; it needs nothing else from the conversation. Returns visually similar eBay listings from the Clothing, Shoes and Accessories category only, in eBay's look-alike order. If the picture does not show one piece of clothing, `matches` is empty and the say line asks what the item is. A short item name in q makes the results match it, which removes look-alikes of the wrong kind.

country.description: Two-letter country code for the eBay site and currency. Defaults to where the request comes from.

image_url.description: Direct https link to one JPEG, PNG or WebP picture, 6 MB at most.

max_price.description: Highest price, in the local currency.

q.description: Which item in the picture, in a few words, for example "the camel coat".

size.description: Clothing or shoe size to match, for example M, 10 or UK 8.

name: wardrobeconnect_find_clothes_by_image
title: Wardrobe Connect: Find clothes that look like a picture
